title: external.data_uploaded (v1)
description: The human has uploaded external experiment data for a LabInTheLoop external experiment. Emitted with envelope.emitter == 'Human'.

external_data_upload_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the uploaded external dataset.

external_experiment_id.description: Id of the external experiment this upload belongs to.

complete.description: Whether this upload completes the external experiment's data collection (true) or is a partial/incremental upload (false).
